how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:hunter-02-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:6101:obj:0: Use the ⟦E2⟧ to tame a ⟦E3⟧. Practice your skills, then return the ⟦E2⟧ to ⟦E4⟧ in Dolanaar.
rows.quest:6101:details:0: The variance of nature is something that can be relied upon, ⟦1⟧. It is predictable in the way that it never remains the same; it is always changing.
rows.quest:6101:details:1: The tasks I give to you will help you to see and appreciate the vast differences of the creatures you may choose as your companion.
rows.quest:6101:details:2: Take this taming rod and use it to tame a nightsaber stalker, found to the south. Practice your skills as a hunter. Then you will begin to understand the similarities and differences of nature.
rows.quest:6101:progress:0: ⟦E5⟧ the balance between nature and oneself is a way of life for every ⟦2⟧.
rows.quest:6101:completion:0: I see your commitment and that you have understood what I have taught you, ⟦3⟧.
rows.quest:6102:obj:0: Use the ⟦E2⟧ to tame a ⟦E6⟧. Practice your skills, then return the ⟦E2⟧ to ⟦E4⟧ in Dolanaar.
rows.quest:6102:details:0: You have tamed two creatures that inhabit the land, now you must tame one that soars the skies. Use the taming rod to tame a strigid screecher, found west of here. Practice your skills with this mighty owl at your side.
rows.quest:6102:details:1: When you return, I will bestow you with the skills you will need to tame an animal of your choosing to be your companion; this creature will face the challenges you face, and gain experience alongside you. I will also show you how to call it and dismiss it as you wish.
rows.quest:6102:progress:0: I am proud of your accomplishments, ⟦4⟧. Have you finished the last task I gave you?
rows.quest:6102:completion:0: You have learned all I can teach you, ⟦5⟧. May I offer you one more piece of advice: use discretion when choosing your first pet. Will you choose a creature of the land, of the water, or of the sky? Whatever it may be, without doubt, your pet will be with you for quite some time.
rows.quest:6102:completion:1: Here you are, ⟦6⟧. I will now give you the power to tame a beast, as well as call it and dismiss it as you see fit. Use your new skills with pride; you have earned them.
rows.quest:6103:obj:0: Speak to ⟦E8⟧ in the Cenarion Enclave, in ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:6103:details:0: You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it.
rows.quest:6103:details:1: ⟦E10⟧ to ⟦E9⟧. There you must speak to one of our most revered hunters, ⟦E8⟧. She will give you the ability to train your new pet, so make haste.
rows.quest:6103:details:2: While ⟦E8⟧ may seem stern, she is always pleased to see another hunter rising through the ranks. Treat her with respect and she will return in kind. Good luck, ⟦7⟧.
rows.quest:6103:completion:0: A fledgling ⟦8⟧. I see. Yes. I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.
rows.quest:6103:completion:1: Remember, ⟦9⟧, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.
rows.quest:6721:details:0: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.
rows.quest:6721:details:1: You must see ⟦E4⟧ in Dolanaar. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.⟦10⟧
rows.quest:6722:details:0: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.
rows.quest:6722:details:1: You must see ⟦E4⟧ in Dolanaar. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.
rows.quest:8151:details:0: ⟦E14⟧ of ⟦E15⟧ has sent out a call for seasoned hunters such as yourself. He is a furbolg hunter who has left his tribe to aid the Cenarion Circle. His teachings are meant to enrich the wisdom of others who share his craft, and guide them toward maintaining a balance. You would do well to speak with him.
rows.quest:8151:details:1: ⟦E14⟧ resides atop the cliffs of ⟦E15⟧, northeast from the Ruins of Eldarath.
rows.quest:8151:completion:0: It is no longer my purpose to hunt, but to teach the ⟦13⟧. That is what fate has handed to me.
rows.quest:8151:completion:1: Craft with me a ⟦14⟧'s charm -- a collection of trophies from fallen prey that will remind you of your past trials and triumphs. In the end I will keep the charm, but reward you with something else.
rows.quest:8153:obj:0: Bring a pair of Perfect ⟦E17⟧ to ⟦E14⟧ in ⟦E15⟧. ⟦E14⟧ resides atop the cliffs northeast of the Ruins of Eldarath.
rows.quest:8153:details:0: The courser wears the mightiest antlers in the known lands. Such antlers are used to defend the courser, goring an attacker and often damaging the points. Perfect, natural antlers are the sign of an animal spirit with supreme confidence.
rows.quest:8153:details:1: To hold such antlers will bestow the same confidence in you.
rows.quest:8153:details:2: Hunt the mosshoof courser, find the perfect antlers and bring them to me.
rows.quest:8153:completion:0: You must possess keen sight and great patience to have obtained these. Well done.
rows.quest:8231:obj:0: Bring 6 ⟦E19⟧ to ⟦E14⟧ in ⟦E15⟧. ⟦E14⟧ resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
rows.quest:8231:details:0: The wavethrasher is an amphibious beast living only here in ⟦E15⟧. They are powerful and resilient.
rows.quest:8231:details:1: The tough, reflective scales from a wavethrasher mirror the strength of the hunter.
rows.quest:8231:details:2: Track and hunt wavethrashers along the coast of ⟦E15⟧, and bring me their scales.
rows.quest:8231:completion:0: The wavethrashers are not easily defeated, even more so in their watery environment.
rows.quest:8231:completion:1: You have proven yourself ready to hunt even deadlier prey.
rows.quest:8232:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E20⟧ to ⟦E14⟧ in ⟦E15⟧. ⟦E14⟧ resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
rows.quest:8232:details:0: Now I set you on a dangerous hunt to slay the green drake, ⟦E21⟧, and bring his tooth to me. ⟦E21⟧ dwells deep in Temple of Atal'Hakkar, the entrance to which lies in ⟦E22⟧.
rows.quest:8232:details:1: If you wish to defeat him, you must not go alone. This drake is an enemy of many -- seek others who wish to destroy him.
rows.quest:8232:details:2: The drake's tooth represents the power a hunter will find in the company of others. Bring it to me and you will have learned much.
rows.quest:8232:progress:0: I see wisdom in your eyes, ⟦15⟧. Has your hunt ended?
rows.quest:8232:completion:0: You have learned the old ways, ⟦16⟧, and for that I offer you a gift from my days as a hunter.
rows.quest:7632:obj:0: Find the owner of the ⟦E24⟧. Good luck, ⟦17⟧; It's a big world.
rows.quest:7632:details:0: The epidermis of the leaf glows a bright green. The surface is extremely rugose, exposing several veins and wrinkles.
rows.quest:7632:details:1: If you had to take a guess, you would say this leaf came from something ancient and powerful.
rows.quest:7632:details:2: Maybe you should find the original owner of this leaf?
rows.quest:7632:completion:0: Of course I recognize my own leaves. Look at that! It's in perfect condition.
rows.quest:7632:completion:1: How good of you to return it, ⟦18⟧.
rows.quest:7632:completion:2: Perhaps you could be of service to us and we to you.
rows.quest:7633:completion:0: Your diligence and integrity has been noted, ⟦19⟧.
rows.quest:7633:completion:1: We are Ancients: Protectors of this once great forest. Our physical forms were destroyed 10,000 years ago when Archimonde and the ⟦E25⟧ marched upon ⟦E26⟧. Our spirits, however, remain intact.
rows.quest:7633:completion:2: There are tasks that we can offer. Tasks that if completed will open up the secrets of the Ancients to you.
rows.quest:7633:completion:3: Know this, should you complete these tasks, merely return to this rock and we shall answer the calling.
rows.quest:7634:obj:0: ⟦E27⟧ has asked that you bring him a ⟦E28⟧. Should you find this sinew, return it to Hastat in ⟦E29⟧.
rows.quest:7634:details:0: Greetings, ⟦20⟧. I am Hastat, Ancient of Lore. I hold knowledge lost eons ago.
rows.quest:7634:details:1: With the proper binding, one of my leaves can serve as a quiver the likes of which has not been seen in 10,000 years. A quiver that when accompanied by a bow of Ancients, could grant untold powers.
rows.quest:7634:details:2: Return here with sinew from an adult blue dragon and this quiver shall be yours.
rows.quest:7634:completion:0: May my leaves provide your arrows protection from harm. May your arrows strike true. May the enemies of our world be smitten.
rows.quest:7635:obj:0: ⟦E32⟧ has asked that you bring him a ⟦E33⟧. Should you find this sinew, return it to Stoma in ⟦E29⟧.
rows.quest:7635:details:0: Vartrus may offer you the stave to create a bow of Ancients but only I can enchant the string required to complete the bow.
rows.quest:7635:details:1: It is a simple task, puny one. Slay a mature black dragon and remove the sinew from its bones. Return that sinew to me and I shall enchant the material into an almost indestructible bow string.
rows.quest:7635:progress:0: I am certain that you will have little difficulty in finding and slaying a black dragon, ⟦22⟧. Do not waste my time with idle chatter.
rows.quest:7635:completion:0: A most foul dragon this one was. The sinew reeks of evil.
rows.quest:7635:completion:1: Give me a moment to cleanse the filth from this flesh and apply the proper enchantments.
rows.quest:7636:obj:0: You must find and destroy these four demonic corrupters:
rows.quest:7636:obj:5: Destroy these creatures and return to ⟦E36⟧ in ⟦E29⟧ with their heads.
rows.quest:7636:obj:6: Refer to the ⟦E37⟧ in your inventory for clues as to their whereabouts.
rows.quest:7636:obj:7: You MUST complete this task by yourself.
rows.quest:7636:details:0: Agents of the ⟦E25⟧ are still active in our world, ⟦23⟧. These agents corrupt all that they touch. Nature wilts and weeps in their presence.
rows.quest:7636:details:1: You must track down these demonic corrupters and destroy them, ⟦24⟧. Be warned, you must engage them by yourself or they will flee. As long as you are alone, they will try and destroy you. You must strike at them, turning their arrogance into misery.
rows.quest:7636:details:2: I grant you a piece of my bark, the inscriptions shall lead you to your targets. Retrieve their heads.
rows.quest:7636:progress:0: Do not be fooled by their disguises!
rows.quest:7636:completion:0: You have served us well, ⟦25⟧! Take this stave and combine it with the bow string that Stoma is able to create. Together, they form a most formidable weapon.
